info.name: USGS Earthquake Notifications, Feeds, and Web Services Catalog Earthquakes API

params.name: format
params.description: Response format. Options: geojson (default), csv, kml, quakeml, text, xml.

params.name: starttime
params.description: Limit events to those occurring after this time. ISO8601 format. Default: NOW minus 30 days.

params.name: endtime
params.description: Limit events to those occurring before this time. ISO8601 format. Default: present.

params.name: updatedafter
params.description: Return events updated after this ISO8601 timestamp.

params.name: minlatitude
params.description: Minimum latitude for rectangle filter in degrees (-90 to 90).

params.name: maxlatitude
params.description: Maximum latitude for rectangle filter in degrees (-90 to 90).

params.name: minlongitude
params.description: Minimum longitude for rectangle filter in degrees (-360 to 360).

params.name: maxlongitude
params.description: Maximum longitude for rectangle filter in degrees (-360 to 360).

params.name: latitude
params.description: Latitude for circle filter center in degrees (-90 to 90).

params.name: longitude
params.description: Longitude for circle filter center in degrees (-360 to 360).

params.name: maxradius
params.description: Maximum search radius for circle filter in degrees (0 to 180).

params.name: maxradiuskm
params.description: Maximum search radius for circle filter in kilometers (0 to 20001.6).

params.name: minmagnitude
params.description: Minimum earthquake magnitude.

params.name: maxmagnitude
params.description: Maximum earthquake magnitude.

params.name: mindepth
params.description: Minimum event depth in kilometers (-100 to 1000).

params.name: maxdepth
params.description: Maximum event depth in kilometers (-100 to 1000).

params.name: eventid
params.description: Retrieve a specific event by its USGS event identifier.

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of events to return (1 to 20000).

params.name: offset
params.description: Starting record number for paginated results (1-based).

params.name: orderby
params.description: Order results by time, time-asc, magnitude, or magnitude-asc.

params.name: catalog
params.description: Filter by earthquake catalog (e.g., us, ci, nc).

params.name: contributor
params.description: Filter by contributing network.

params.name: eventtype
params.description: Filter by event type (earthquake, explosion, quarry blast, etc.).

params.name: alertlevel
params.description: Filter by PAGER alert level (green, yellow, orange, red).

params.name: minsig
params.description: Minimum significance value (integer, 0+).

params.name: maxsig
params.description: Maximum significance value.

params.name: reviewstatus
params.description: Filter by review status (automatic or reviewed).

params.name: producttype
params.description: Filter by product type associated with the event (moment-tensor, focal-mechanism, shakemap, losspager, dyfi).

params.name: includedeleted
params.description: Include deleted events in results (true, false, or only).

params.name: includeallorigins
params.description: Include all origin solutions in results.

params.name: includeallmagnitudes
params.description: Include all magnitude estimates in results.

params.name: nodata
params.description: HTTP status code to return when no data is found (204 or 404).

items.docs: Search the USGS earthquake catalog using geographic, temporal, magnitude, depth, and other filters. Returns earthquake events in the requested format (GeoJSON by default). Supports both rectangle and circle spatial filters, with a maximum of 20,000 events per request.

params.name: format
params.description: Response format (geojson or text).

params.name: starttime
params.description: Start time in ISO8601 format.

params.name: endtime
params.description: End time in ISO8601 format.

params.name: minmagnitude
params.description: Minimum earthquake magnitude.

params.name: maxmagnitude
params.description: Maximum earthquake magnitude.

params.name: minlatitude
params.description: Minimum latitude for rectangle filter.

params.name: maxlatitude
params.description: Maximum latitude for rectangle filter.

params.name: minlongitude
params.description: Minimum longitude for rectangle filter.

params.name: maxlongitude
params.description: Maximum longitude for rectangle filter.

items.docs: Return the number of earthquake events matching the query parameters without returning event data. Accepts the same parameters as the query endpoint.
